subject: Social Media
title: The Hook Model
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Hook Model.

hook.text: You check your phone 96 times a day. Not because you planned to—because apps hooked you.

buildup.text: Nir Eyal's Hook Model: Trigger → Action → Variable reward → Investment. Repeat until habit forms.

discovery.text: The variable reward is key. Slot machines and feeds both use it—you never know what's next.

twist.text: Eyal later wrote a book on breaking these habits. The man who taught companies to addict you recanted.

climax.text: Every major platform follows the Hook Model. The notification is the trigger. The scroll is the reward.

punchline.text: The hook isn't a feature. It's the whole product.

quiz.question: What is the key element that makes the Hook Model addictive?
